39/S0.subgoal: Explain the three broad categories of interaction in immersive systems.

39/S1.subgoal: Explain the parameters that determine the suitability of different selection techniques.

39/S2.subgoal: Describe various hand selection techniques, including virtual hand, go-go, prism, and intent-driven selection.

39/S3.subgoal: Describe pointing-based selection techniques, including ray casting, bend cast, and depth ray.

39/S4.subgoal: Describe image plane and volumetric selection techniques.

39/S6.subgoal: Describe indirect manipulation techniques like 3D widgets, proxies, and World in Miniature.

39/S7.subgoal: Describe bimanual and integrated hybrid manipulation techniques like spindle and HOMER.

39/S8.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
